<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/driver-odata`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **128** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/drivers/driver-odata/LICENSE`, `packages/drivers/driver-odata/README.md`, `packages/drivers/driver-odata/package.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**49** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3cc4563e1e0cead21e76d3b09da732499e771ca7`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/drivers/driver-odata/LICENSE`, `packages/drivers/driver-odata/README.md`, `packages/drivers/driver-odata/package.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `isArray (5 routes)`
- **57** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **167** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3cc4563e1e0cead21e76d3b09da732499e771ca7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5958e95120f576f401e358cc206d59d9528e7911` — the merge of head `7f91132b87090f7c0bd8902f0fe17808ca63a6e0` into base `3cc4563e1e0cead21e76d3b09da732499e771ca7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5958e95120f576f401e358cc206d59d9528e7911 && git checkout 5958e95120f576f401e358cc206d59d9528e7911
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3cc4563e1e0cead21e76d3b09da732499e771ca7 7f91132b87090f7c0bd8902f0fe17808ca63a6e0 && git checkout -B drift-repro 3cc4563e1e0cead21e76d3b09da732499e771ca7 && git merge --no-ff 7f91132b87090f7c0bd8902f0fe17808ca63a6e0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3cc4563e1e0cead21e76d3b09da732499e771ca7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3cc4563e1e0cead21e76d3b09da732499e771ca7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
ACCEPT · PR #27796 @ `7f91132b87090f7c0bd8902f0fe17808ca63a6e0` · 2026-10-30T00:42Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新包 `@objectstack/driver-odata`：声明式 OData v4 数据源驱动，以插件驱动 id `driver.odata` 发布。管理员声明数据源和对象（`external.remoteName` 指实体集，`external.columnMap` 改字段名），就能实时读写 SAP、Dynamics 365 这类 OData 服务，不用写代码。
- **为什么改：** epic #27261 P2（裁决 6486145005，Tier B = 声明式 OData）。按您的指示只做 v4，方言接缝已留好，v2 以后另立卡。
- **风险与回滚：** 全是新包，不动 spec schema，也不进 `DRIVER_VOCABULARY`，引擎兜底层会在内存里重放整条查询，驱动只下推"只会多、不会少"的过滤。凭据只走 `external.credentialsRef`，解析失败一律拒绝。另外两处小改：`packages/spec/llms.txt` 包数 72→73，changeset `fixed` 组加入新包。还原即回滚。
- **先看：** `packages/drivers/driver-odata/src/filter.ts`（下推规则），`transport.ts`（认证、同源链接、超时）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-odata test`，预期 439 条全部通过。
- **需要你做的：** APPROVE 一次（改动 3748 行，超过 3000 行门槛）。本 PR 不碰契约面（`Clause-②: no`，无 `packages/spec/src/**`），席位审读即审核记录；head `7f91132b87090f7c0bd8902f0fe17808ca63a6e0`。

席位意见：ACCEPT。席位在 `bcc0a1a3` 审出一个 must-fix，已在当前 head 修复并复核。

## 席位核对

1. **Shape:** +3746/−2, 26 files. A new package under `packages/drivers/driver-odata` (driver, v4 dialect behind an `ODataDialect` seam, `$filter` translator, transport, plugin, fixtures and tests), its changeset and `fixed`-group entry, the `llms.txt` package count, and the lockfile.
2. **Premise measured / seat review:** read `filter.ts`, `dialect-v4.ts` (literals, quoting, `inList`), `transport.ts` and `plugin.ts` in full, and `odata-driver.ts`'s read path and URL building.
   - Holds: every translation is a superset of the engine's reading. `$not` is never pushed. Text ordering and negation are left to the engine. The nullable `$ne`/`$nin` forms carry `or P eq null`.
   - Holds: `@odata.nextLink` is followed only on the service root's origin, and `redirect: 'manual'` is set, so the credential never leaves the configured host.
   - Holds: the floor's `limit: EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP + 1` bounds the `nextLink` loop. String literals double `'`, and every URL segment and query value is `encodeURIComponent`-ed.
   - Holds: the credential is resolved at the first request, never at boot. A missing ref, store or secret fails closed, and a `credentialsRef` under `auth: none` is refused.
   - **Must-fix found at `bcc0a1a3`, fixed at `7f91132b`:** single-value `$nin` emitted `not Age eq 1`. `not` binds tighter than `eq`, so a service refuses it, and on a nullable property the `or Age eq null` fell under the `not` and dropped null rows. Fix: `not (LIST)` always. New exact-string rows (nullable, non-nullable key, boolean). The fixture service now parses `not` at OData precedence. New conformance cases under both collations were reproduced red on the old line and are green on the fix.
3. **Gate check-runs on `7f91132b`:** 65 runs: 58 success, 7 skipped, 0 failed or pending. `mergeable_state: clean`. Local: 439/439, typecheck 0, eslint 0; 49 derived gates, all exit 0.
4. **Accepted deviations:** `packages/spec/llms.txt` (a count line, outside `packages/spec/src/**`), required by `check:llms-txt` for any new published package. The PR body's 3691-line figure predates the fix; it is 3748 now.
5. **Out of scope, routed:** there is no `$batch` arm, and bulk verbs are refused by name (a later card if a customer needs it). D7 connector-credential wiring and running #27744's conformance kit from this package go to whichever of #27746 / #27798 lands after this PR. `$metadata` import (#27745) and the guide (#27747) are dispatched after this lands. Skills-docs: #27747.
6. **Landing:** size-governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 27796`: 3748 lines > 3000; no governed path). The PR stays a draft with `needs-user-decision`, and review is requested from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. After an APPROVED review, the seat clears the label, then `pr_ready` and `automerge_enable` through the relay.
